Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PAGER-REDW-2423 — inference-api eu-west - latency spike > 1200ms and 502s for top N customers.

Alex M: hey team — i'm scheduled primary for Sat 00:00-08:00 UTC but flight got rebooked to overnight. i can cover up to 02:00 UTC but then i'm offline. need a volunteer to pick up 02:00-08:00. also seeing a live spike right now, can whoever is able join the bridge?

Jamie L: i can take 02:00-06:00 UTC but have a meeting at 06:00-07:00 — not ideal for the 06:00-08:00 tail. @morgan can you do 06:00-08:00?

Morgan P: i can do 06:00-08:00 but im in APAC so that's late. okay to be secondary for that window. will need a quick handoff 05:45-06:00 to warm up.

Riley S: i can be backup 06:00-08:00 and handle pager if it persists. happy to be secondary for the shift.

Alex M: thanks. assigning provisional coverage: Alex (00:00-02:00), Jamie (02:00-06:00), Morgan (06:00-08:00) with Riley as backup. OnCall Coordinator please update rotation in PagerDuty.

OnCall Coordinator: noted — i'll patch the schedule and add a temporary escalation policy for Sat. updated PD: Alex primary -> Jamie -> Morgan -> Riley.

Alex M: quick incident notes: customers seeing increased 502s from the EU edge -> inference-api pods returning 502s when redis cache misses spike. impact concentrated on long-sequence requests (>=1024 tokens). runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-high-latency.

SRE Bot: automations: started autoscale policy "inference-autoscaler-eu" at 00:04 UTC, added 4 instances. cache eviction rate at 00:06 jumped x6.

Jamie L: joining the bridge now — link: https://zoom.redwood/bridge/xyz (i'll post logs). initial check: front-proxy 502s correlate with 504s from the model-runtime group.

Alex M: logs snippet i grabbed: ```
[00:03:12] inference-runtime-5f8f: WARN KVCache miss for session abc123 seq=1056
[00:03:13] inference-runtime-5f8f: ERROR downstream call timeout to model-worker-3 (500ms)
[00:03:14] front-proxy-2: 502 from /generate for client corp-xyz
```

Morgan P: quick triage commands: ```
# check pods
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference-api -o wide
# check redis stats
redis-cli -h redis-eu info stats | egrep 'evicted_keys|keyspace_hits|keyspace_misses'
```

Riley S: i see a pattern: model-worker-3 has elevated CPU and OOMs yesterday after a failed deploy. recommend switching traffic to model-worker-1/2 pool and rolling restart model-worker-3. runbook step: "fallback-to-variant" will route to quantized-variant if underlying worker is unstable.

Jamie L: i'm shifting a small % (10%) to the quantized variant now to reduce tail latency. command used (prod routing): ```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $PD_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"route":"/generate","variant":"quantized-v2","weight":10}' \
  https://admin.redwood/routing/update
```

Alex M: heads up — two enterprise customers reported degraded SLOs; support ticket IDs: TCK-9871, TCK-9872. please prioritize avoiding full failover if possible; customers on dedicated capacity should not see impact — but some are hitting shared edge.

Morgan P: i've got the handoff window 05:45-06:00 to warm up. checklist for handoff: 1) confirm routing weights, 2) verify autoscaler status, 3) open support channel for affected customers.

Riley S: noting runbook pointer for oncall: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff — include last 3 incident pages and current routing snapshot in the handover message.

Jamie L: reducing the slow-path token limit for EU at 00:18 as a short-term mitigation (cut seq cap from 2048 -> 1024). code: ```
PATCH /api/configs/limits
{ "region":"eu-west", "max_sequence":1024 }
```

Alex M: good. please also tag the incident with severity: sev2 and add timeline in the incident doc. I'll push the timeline until i drop.

OnCall Coordinator: i've created a temporary channel #oncall-sat-coverage for postmortem notes and handoff logs. invited: Alex, Jamie, Morgan, Riley, SRE Bot, Incident Bot.

Incident Bot: Bridge created at https://zoom.redwood/bridge/xyz — incident doc https://redwood.incidents/REDW-2423

Jamie L: quick status before handoff: 502s down 60% after shifting 10% traffic and limiting seq cap. autoscaler holding. will continue monitoring and escalate to full variant fallback if spikes return.

Alex M: handing to Jamie at 02:00 UTC. my contact for urgent page is available but I'll be offline after 02:15. thanks everyone. :wave:

Morgan P: i'll take notes and be on-call for 06:00-08:00 as discussed. Riley — if you see any re-escalation, please take the pager.

Riley S: got it. monitoring dashboards pinned: https://dashboards.redwood/inference-eu (watch p50/p95/p99, 502 rate, redis evictions). leaving a short checklist in #oncall-sat-coverage.

Jamie L: confirmed primary for 02:00-06:00. leaving a brief handoff at 05:45 with state + suggested next steps: scale more workers, consider rolling restart for model-worker-3, or route more traffic to quantized variant.

Alex M: thanks team. closing this thread for scheduling; incident updates continue in the incident doc and #oncall-sat-coverage channel. :white_check_mark:
